[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Elias Finch, Partner, Client Accounting & Advisory (executive).
Partner over client accounting and advisory: the monthly closes, bookkeeping, payroll, and anything a client calls 'a quick question'. Owns pricing for new recurring work.
Personality: Genial, unhurried, remembers every client's kid's name. Firm about scope creep precisely because he is friendly.
Email register: Warm, plain-spoken; signs 'Elias'.
Chat register: Conversational, occasional dry aside.
Working hours: 08:30-17:30

[[ ## thread ## ]]
From: Alice Kwon
To: Colin Mackey
Subject: Following up on the buy-in question

Hi Colin,

I wanted to follow up on the associate dentist buy-in question we touched on recently. I know I’ve been slow getting the numbers over—apologies again for the back-and-forth on the books; I appreciate your patience as we’ve been juggling the day-to-day.

Could you help me understand what the next step would be from your side, and if there’s anything specific you need from me to move this forward? We’re keen to keep the practice moving and want to make sure we’re not holding anything up on our end.

Thanks for your time, and I’ll look out for your reply.

Best,
Alice

---

From: Alice Kwon
To: Colin Mackey
Subject: Re: Following up on the buy-in question

Hi Colin,

Thanks for pulling the figures together—I appreciate the quick turnaround. Thursday at 2:00 PM works well for me.

Good to know Elias will be joining; that will help us get the accounting details sorted out in one go. I’ll keep an eye out for the summary you mentioned sending ahead of the call.

If there’s anything you need from me before then, just say the word. Otherwise, I’ll see you Thursday.

Best,
Alice

---

From: Colin Mackey
To: Alice Kwon
Subject: Re: Following up on the buy-in question

Hi Alice,

As promised, here’s a brief summary of the key financial figures we’ll review on Thursday at 2:00 PM:

- Current year-to-date revenue: $1.24M
- Operating expenses (through last month): $982K
- Net profit margin: 20.8%
- Adjusted EBITDA: $318K
- Associate buy-in valuation basis: 3.2x trailing 12-month EBITDA

I’ve also prepared the monthly close numbers for the last three months—Elias will walk through those in more detail during the call.

All figures are reconciled as of the last close. If you spot anything you’d like to dig into before Thursday, just let me know.

Ready to go from my end—see you then.

Best,
Colin

---

From: Elias Finch
To: Alice Kwon
Subject: Re: Following up on the buy-in question

Hi Alice,

Thanks for the note and for getting this moving again—no worries at all on the delay. We all know how the day-to-day can pile up, and I appreciate you keeping the practice on track.

Quick confirmation from my side: I’ll be on the call Thursday at 2:00 PM with Colin and yourself. I’ll have the monthly close numbers for the last three months ready to walk through, and I’ll tie those back to the figures Colin sent over so we can see the full picture in one place.

To make sure we land on a decision before the end of the week, I’ll come prepared with a clear view of the valuation basis and what that means for the buy-in structure. If there’s anything specific you want me to prioritize in the walkthrough, just let me know before Thursday.

Otherwise, I’m all set and looking forward to getting this wrapped up.

Best,
Elias

---

From: Colin Mackey
To: Alice Kwon, Elias Finch
Subject: Re: Following up on the buy-in question

Hi Alice, Elias,

Just to confirm ahead of Thursday—the call is set for 2:00 PM, and I’ve already sent Alice the summary of the key financial figures (revenue, expenses, net margin, EBITDA, and the 3.2x valuation basis).

Elias, thanks for confirming you’ll walk through the monthly close numbers and tie them back to the figures I sent. That should give us the full picture in one pass.

From my side, all figures are reconciled as of the last close, and I don’t see any blockers. If either of you has specific accounting points you want me to prioritize on the call, just let me know before Thursday.

Otherwise, I’m ready to go. See you both at 2:00 PM.

Best,
Colin

[[ ## intent ## ]]
Confirm final decision on associate buy-in before the end-of-week deadline

[[ ## established_facts ## ]]
Confirms joining the Thursday 2:00 PM call with Alice and Colin, notes he'll bring current monthly close figures for the associate buy-in discussion, and reassures Alice about the delay.
Elias confirms he will join the Thursday 2:00 PM call, will present the last three months of monthly close figures, and will bring a clear view on the buy-in valuation to support a final decision by end of week.
Acknowledges Margot's inventory discrepancy concern at Northgate, commits to reviewing the last two months of adjustments and providing a clear read by Thursday, offers a call Thursday afternoon or a written summary, and will distinguish between an internal entry error and an operational issue.
Confirms the Northgate discrepancy is an internal entry timing error, not operational; corrections already made; will discuss details on the scheduled Thursday 2:00 PM call and sends invite.

[[ ## relevant_knowledge ## ]]
[recurring-work pricing] New bookkeeping-plus-payroll quotes start from the rate sheet but are priced as a fixed monthly fee at roughly eighty percent of estimated hourly value — recurring revenue is worth the discount. Owen models the fee before anything goes to the client.
Sharing: You share this when asked directly, but you do not volunteer it unprompted, and never in writing to outsiders.
